title: Asappurisa
text: 1.2. Savatthi || || Tatravoca || || 2. Asappurisañ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sappurisañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 4. Katamo ca bhikkhave asappuriso || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti || micchāsaṅkappo micchāvāco micchākammanto micchāājīvo micchāvāyāmo micchāsati micchāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave asappuriso || || 5. Katamo ca bhikkhave sappuriso || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti || sammāsaṅkappo sammāvāco sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi [page 020] 20 Magga-Saṃyuttam XLV.
